name: signal-only-ui
description: Signal-only replies in Claude Code: the model writes the substance (verdict, decision, done, read), a themed renderer draws the form — folded details, hidden observer reports, a witness check. Four themes, and a skill to design your own. Needs function hooks (early access).

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Which renderer draws the reply card: receipt, kanban, gmorel, or a theme file name under hooks/themes/.

prices.title: API price table
prices.description: USD per million tokens for the cost footer: comma-separated family:input/output overrides, e.g. opus:15/75,sonnet:3/15. Unlisted families keep the built-in defaults.

observerMark.title: Witness check for observers
observerMark.description: Hide background-observer reports and put a small dim green check on the card while an observer agent is running.

foldNarration.title: Fold narration between tool calls
foldNarration.description: Collapse assistant text blocks that are followed by a tool call in the same turn into one dim line.

foldNotifications.title: Fold task notifications and peer messages
foldNotifications.description: Collapse task-notification, peer and scheduled-trigger messages into one dim line with a count.

observerTypes.title: Observer agent types
observerTypes.description: Comma-separated agent definition names counted as observers for the witness check. /signal agents shows the names $.agent.list() reports.
